cancer.title: Advanced cancer care by Amigos en Mundo LLC
cancer.body: Three treatment approaches. Every plan starts with a physician review of your reports.

targeted.intro: Lutetium-177, Terbium-161 and Actinium-225 are radioactive isotopes used in targeted radioligand therapy (theranostics). They bind to surface proteins such as PSMA (prostate-specific membrane antigen) and are used in cancers such as metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) and neuroendocrine tumors.

isotopes.name: Lutetium-177
isotopes.howText: Beta particles travel up to a few millimeters, creating a 'crossfire' effect that reaches bulky, heterogeneous tumors and nearby cells.
isotopes.useText: The established clinical benchmark; an FDA-approved radioligand therapy, for example for PSMA-positive prostate cancer.

isotopes.name: Terbium-161
isotopes.howText: Similar to Lu-177, plus Auger and internal conversion electrons that release high energy over an extremely short distance, giving a stronger local dose to micro-tumors and single-cell metastases.
isotopes.useText: A newer, emerging option studied for small-volume disease, post-surgical residual disease, or progression after Lu-177 therapy.

isotopes.name: Actinium-225
isotopes.howText: Alpha particles travel only a few cell widths but carry massive energy, causing severe, irreparable DNA breaks in cancer cells.
isotopes.useText: Targeted alpha therapy, often for treatment-resistant or advanced disease that no longer responds to Lu-177, or combined with Lu-177 ('tandem therapy').

penetration.title: Penetration range
penetration.tb161: extremely short range, high local dose

info.title: WHAT IS THE CYTOTRON?
info.intro: The Cytotron is a whole-body, non-invasive medical device that uses Rotational Field Quantum Magnetic Resonance (RFQMR) to deliver high-intensity, pulsed electromagnetic fields to specific tissues in the body.

items.title: Tumor destruction
items.body: Designed to target solid tumors (such as breast, liver and pancreas) and abnormally regenerating tissue by inducing programmed cell death (apoptosis).

items.title: Tissue regeneration
items.body: Also explored in certain contexts for tissue regeneration, osteoarthritis and hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE).

items.title: Designations
items.body: FDA designation covers specific solid tumors (breast, liver, pancreas). Regulatory review is ongoing in various countries.

trust: Partner clinic in India · treatment plans issued only after medical file verification.
cytotron.disclaimer: Individual results may vary. Treatment is prescribed by a licensed physician. Information on this page is not medical advice.

radiation.h3: Elekta Versa HD LINAC with Stereotactic Robotic 6D Couch
radiation.intro: An advanced radiation therapy system used to treat a wide range of cancers throughout the body with extreme precision. It delivers high doses of radiation directly to tumors while protecting surrounding healthy tissue.

areas.name: Brain and spine
areas.note: Precision treatment for primary tumors or metastases.

areas.name: Lung and liver
areas.note: Tumors that move as the patient breathes.

areas.name: Prostate
areas.note: Tumors that can shift with internal organ fullness.

areas.name: Head and neck
areas.note: Cancers very close to critical structures such as the optic nerve or brainstem.

hardware.title: The LINAC (Versa HD)
hardware.intro: Generates high-energy X-rays or electrons and shapes them exactly to the form of the tumor.

rows.label: High dose-rate delivery
rows.text: Radiation is delivered rapidly, so the patient lies still for less time.

rows.label: Dynamic beam shaping
rows.text: A High-Definition Multi-Leaf Collimator (HD-MLC) uses dozens of tiny computer-controlled tungsten leaves to block healthy tissue and leave the tumor exposed.

rows.label: Real-time imaging
rows.text: 4D CT scans before and during treatment verify the tumor's exact location.

hardware.title: The Robotic 6D Couch
hardware.intro: A standard couch adjusts in 3 directions. The 6D hexapod couch adds 3 rotational axes to correct the slightest misalignment.
hardware.caption: 6 degrees of freedom

steps.title: Robotic correction
steps.text: The 6D couch rotates and shifts to align the tumor with the beam.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.text: The LINAC delivers the targeted radiation dose.

admission.title: Student admission, explained
admission.intro: Student admission is the formal process by which a school, college or university evaluates applicants and accepts them into its programs. Admission is an offer of a seat; enrollment happens afterwards, when the student accepts the offer, pays fees and officially registers.

stages.title: Submitting the application
bullets: Application form via a portal or the university website
Supporting documents: transcripts and diplomas, test scores (SAT, ACT, GRE, IELTS/TOEFL), personal statement, recommendation letters, CV or portfolio

stages.title: Review and evaluation
bullets: Initial screening for completeness and cutoffs
Selection: merit-based, holistic review or interview
